provider_id.hint: Leave empty to use the current session provider.

max_concurrent_jobs.hint: Large analyses can consume model tokens and CPU. Keep this low unless the host has enough resources.

auto_build.description: Automatically install and build bundled Understand Anything Node packages
auto_build.hint: When enabled, the first use runs pnpm install and rebuilds missing runtime dist files.

auto_update_poll_interval.hint: 0 disables background polling. Use chat commands for explicit updates.

allowed_roots.hint: Empty means the current AstrBot working directory. Add absolute directories to allow analyzing projects elsewhere.

default_write_mode.hint: Understand Anything writes graph files into the target project.
